results.text: Among the most surprising results, an M-BERT model that has been ﬁne-tuned using only POS- labeled Urdu (written in Arabic script), achieves 91% accuracy on Hindi (written in Devanagari script), even though it has never seen a single POS- tagged Devanagari word. This provides clear ev- idence of M-BERT’s multilingual representation ability, mapping structures onto new vocabularies based on a shared representation induced solely from monolingual language model training data.
